market.market_question: Will Example State certify the Metro Rail funding package by July 31, 2026?
market.resolution_criteria: Resolves Yes if Example State publishes an official certification or final approval notice for the Metro Rail funding package on or before 2026-07-31. Draft notices, committee recommendations, or unofficial social posts do not resolve the market.
